caption: The drawing shows a handmade rag doll standing upright, dressed in period clothing. The doll has a round, pale face with simple facial features: small, black eyes, a triangular nose, and small red lips. It wears a bonnet or cap that is tied under the chin with a ribbon and features ruffled fabric edges. The dress is long-sleeved, with a fitted bodice, gathered at the neck with a ribbon, and a cinched waist leading to a full, ankle-length skirt. The entire outfit, including the bonnet, is made from a light beige or tan fabric that appears to have a subtle floral pattern in muted earth tones, particularly browns and reds. The doll has stockings peeking from beneath the skirt, and it wears black shoes with a small strap and apparent white lace around the top of the socks. To the right of the doll, there is a separate rectangular swatch of the dress fabric, clearly displaying the floral pattern and colors in more detail. The background is plain and unadorned. The name "FRANCES LICHTEN" is written below the feet of the doll.
title: Rag Doll
